Definition: What proportion of businesses does the register cover?
Comments: Assumed high for formal businesses via APIP.

revision_notes: Evidence is mixed. revision_notes: Confirmed and strengthened (original fdsi.gov.gn PDF returned a 403 error on fetch). revision_notes: Could not confirm or reject the original estimate. 977,610 households / 4,860,075 individuals were surveyed nationally by December 2023, but no authoritative source gives the size of the intended beneficiary population (poor/vulnerable target group) needed to calculate a reliable coverage percentage. A rough comparison to Guinea's total household count (approx. 2.3-2.5 million, from a population of about 14 million) implies coverage nearer 40%, below the original band, but this denominator may not match the intended definition. Left unchanged, flagged for human review to clarify the correct denominator.

Definition: Is the register integrated with the business register?
Comments: Business registration generates TIN via APIP.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed with additional authoritative sources. The Doing Business Guinea country profile and a World Bank MSME project appraisal document both confirm APIP operates as a single-window (guichet unique) that registers a company with the Commercial Registry (RCCM) and issues the tax ID (NIF) as part of the same process. This supports partial integration (a shared intake process); full system-level (database) integration between DGI and RCCM was not independently evidenced, so the score is kept at 4 rather than raised to 5.
